# Parametric GPIO IP - Firmware & Driver Documentation

## 1. Upstream GitHub Provenance
* **Origin**: ETH Zurich (PULP Platform) wrapping OpenTitan (lowRISC) GPIO
* **Repository**: [pulp-platform/gpio](https://github.com/pulp-platform/gpio) (branch `master`)
* **Core RTL**: Auto-generated by OpenTitan `reggen` tool
* **Firmware Origin**:
  * PULP HAL: [pulp-platform/gpio/hal/gpio_hal.h](https://github.com/pulp-platform/gpio/blob/master/hal/gpio_hal.h)
  * PULP Sys Lib: [pulp-platform/pulpino](https://github.com/pulp-platform/pulpino) (`gpio.h`, `gpio.c`)
  * OpenTitan DIF: [lowRISC/opentitan](https://github.com/lowRISC/opentitan) (`dif_gpio.h`, `dif_gpio.c`)

## 2. RTL Match & Verification Status
* `gpio_reg_pkg.sv`: **100% Identical** to upstream `pulp-platform/gpio/src/gpio_reg_pkg.sv`.
* `gpio_reg_top.sv`: **100% Identical** to upstream `pulp-platform/gpio/src/gpio_reg_top.sv` (453 KB).
* `gpio_axi_lite_wrap.sv`: **100% Identical** to upstream.
* `gpio_input_stage.sv`: **100% Identical** to upstream.
* `gpio_input_stage_no_clk_gates.sv`: Inlined edge-detect gates to eliminate external `common_cells` dependency.

## 3. SoC Memory Map & Registers
* **Base Address**: `0x40003000` (APB[3])
| Offset | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `0x080` | `GPIO_EN` | 32-bit Output Enable mask |
| `0x100` | `GPIO_IN` | 32-bit Pin input read |
| `0x180` | `GPIO_OUT` | Direct 32-bit pin output write |
| `0x200` | `GPIO_SET` | Atomic bit set (W1S) |
| `0x280` | `GPIO_CLEAR` | Atomic bit clear (W1C) |
| `0x300` | `GPIO_TOGGLE`| Atomic bit toggle |
| `0x380` | `GPIO_RISE_EN` | Rising edge interrupt enable |
| `0x400` | `GPIO_FALL_EN` | Falling edge interrupt enable |
| `0x580` | `GPIO_INTR_STAT` | Interrupt status (W1C clear) |

## 4. Interrupt Routing
* GPIO Global Interrupt -> Core `fast_irq_i[0]` (Cause 16, `mip[16]`)
* Pin level interrupts -> Routed to top-level SoC ports `gpio_pin_level_interrupts_o`
